content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have: A Graduate degree. Passed a minimum of 4 Actuarial Papers (excluding CB3) from IAI/IFoA. Desirable Qualification: Proficiency in R, Python or SQL.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The minimum age of the apprentice should be 21 years as on 01 September 2026 . Age relaxation will be applicable according to Government norms.

content_sections.heading: Apprenticeship Period
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will be engaged as Actuarial Apprentices for a period of 11 months on a contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Posting Location
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be posted at: Corporate Office, The Oriental Insurance Company Limited, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process will consist of: Shortlisting of eligible candidates Personal Interview before the Interview Panel Final selection based on interview performance The qualifying marks for the Personal Interview will be decided by the Company. Interview details will be communicated through the Company website and/or email.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The apprentice will be considered as a trainee and not as an employee or worker of the Company. The apprenticeship will not provide any right or guarantee for future employment in the Company. Completion of apprenticeship will not provide preference or entitlement in future recruitment. Apprentices will not be eligible for employee benefits applicable to regular employees. No deduction towards Provident Fund, Staff Mediclaim or similar employee benefits will be made from the stipend. Apprentices will be entitled to one day leave per month with prior permission. No overtime allowance will be provided. On satisfactory completion of training, an Apprenticeship Certificate will be awarded.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Oriental Insurance Actuarial Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the Career section of The Oriental Insurance Company Limited website. Download the prescribed application form. Fill all required details in the application form. Attach a recent passport-size photograph. Sign the application form as per instructions. Send the scanned copy of the application through email. Send the hard copy of the application to the prescribed address.

content_sections.heading: Application Submission Details
content_sections.text: Email Address: [email protected] Advance Scanned Application Last Date: 6 November 2026

content_sections.heading: Postal Address
content_sections.text: Dy. General Manager (HR) The Oriental Insurance Company Limited Corporate Office Block-IV, Plate-I, NBCC Office Complex Kidwai Nagar East New Delhi-110023

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates called for interview must bring original certificates and self-attested copies of required documents. Date of Birth Certificate / Matriculation Certificate Graduation and Post Graduation Certificates Mark Sheets including CGPA conversion documents Professional Qualification Certificates Experience Certificate or supporting documents Caste Certificate / EWS Certificate PwBD Certificate, if applicable Ex-Servicemen Certificate, if applicable No Objection Certificate from present employer, if applicable Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, Driving Licence, Voter ID, Passport etc.) Proof of passing required Actuarial Examination subjects Original certificates should not be attached with the Interview Data Sheet. Only self-attested copies should be submitted. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must ensure they fulfil age and qualification requirements before appearing for the interview. Incomplete information in the Interview Data Sheet may lead to rejection. SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen candidates must produce valid certificates in the prescribed format. Original documents are required for verification of eligibility. If any information provided by a candidate is found incorrect, candidature may be cancelled. Candidates must keep their registered email ID and mobile number active throughout the selection process.
